verses.geez:
ወጸውዐ፡ ኤልሳዕ፡ ነቢይ፡ ፩እምውስተ፡ ደቀ፡ ነቢያት፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ቅንት፡ ሐቇከ፡ ወንሣእ፡ ቀርነ፡ ቅብእ፡ ምስሌከ፡
            ወሖር፡ ሬማተ፡ ዘገለአድ።
verses.translation: And Elisaie the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, Gird up thy loins, and take this cruse of oil in thy hand, and go to Remmoth Galaad.

verses.geez:
ወባእ፡ ህየ፡ ወኅሥሦ፡ በህየ፡ ለኢዩ፡ ወልደ፡ ኢዮሳፍጥ፡ ወልደ፡ ናሜሲ፡ ወባእ፡ ወአንሥኦ፡ እማእከለ፡ አኀዊሁ፡
            ወአብኦ፡ ውስተ፡ ውሳጢተ፡ ጽርሕ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt enter there, and shalt see there Ju the son of Josaphat son of Namessi, and shalt go in and make him rise up from among his brethren, and shalt bring him into a secret chamber.

verses.geez:
ወንሣእ፡ ቀርነ፡ ቅብእ፡ ወሱጥ፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሱ፡ ወበሎ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ቀባእኩከአ፡ ትንግሥአ፡ ላዕለ፡
            እስራኤልአ፡ ወእምዝ፡ አርኁ፡ ኆኅተ፡ ወጕየይ፡ ወኢትቁም።
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the cruse of oil, and pour it on his head, and say thou, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee king over Israel: and thou shalt open the door, and flee, and not tarry.

verses.geez: ወሖረ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወልደ፡ ነቢይ፡ ውስተ፡ ሬማት፡ ዘገለአድ።
verses.translation: And the young man the prophet went to Remmoth Galaad.

verses.geez:
ወረከበ፡ መላእክተ፡ ሰራዊት፡ ይነብሩ፡ ወይቤ፡ ብየ፡ ዘእነግረከ፡ መልአክ፡ ወይቤ፡ ኢዩ፡ መኑ፡ እምውስቴትነ፡ ወይቤሎ፡
            ኪያከ፡ መልአክ።
verses.translation: And he went in, and, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have a message to thee, O captain. And Ju said, To which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.

verses.geez:
ወተንሥአ፡ ወቦአ፡ ቤተ፡ ወሶጠ፡ ቅብአ፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሱ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላከ፡ እስራኤል፡
            ቀባእኩከአ፡ ትንግሥአ፡ ለሕዝበአ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለእስራኤልአ ፤
verses.translation: And he arose, and went into the house: and he poured the oil upon his head, and said to him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I have anointed thee to be king over the people of the Lord, even over Israel.

verses.geez:
ከመአ፡ ትሠርዎአ፡ ለቤተአ፡ አካአብ፡ እግዚእከ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጽየ፡ ወትትበቀል፡ ደሞሙ፡ ለነቢያት፡ ለአግብርትየ፡ ወደመ፡
            ኵሎሙ፡ አግብርተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምነ፡ እዴሃ፡ ለኤልዛቤል ፤
verses.translation: And thou shalt utterly destroy the house of Achaab thy master from before me, and shalt avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the Lord, at the hand of Jezabel,

verses.geez:
ወእምእደ፡ ኵሉ፡ ቤቱ፡ ለአካአብ፡ ወትሤርዎ፡ ለቤተ፡ አካአብ፡ እስከ፡ ዘያስተአዝብ፡ በኀበ፡ አረፍት፡ ወኵሎ፡ ቅሩበ፡
            ዘይከውን፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘተረፈ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: and at the hand of the whole house of Achaab: and thou shalt utterly cut off from the house of Achaab every male, and him that is shut up and left in Israel.

verses.geez: ወእሬስዮ፡ ለቤተ፡ አካአብ፡ ከመ፡ ቤተ፡ ኢዮራብአም፡ ወልደ፡ ናባጥ፡ ወከመ፡ ቤተ፡ በአስ፡ ወልደ፡ አኪያ።
verses.translation: And I will make the house of Achaab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, and as the house of Baasa the son of Achia.

verses.geez: ወለኢያዛቤል፡ ከለባት፡ ይበልዕዋ፡ በብሔረ፡ እስራኤልአ፡ ወኢትረክብአ፡ ዘይቀብራአ ፤ ወእምዝ፡ አርኀወ፡ ኆኅተ፡ ወጐየ።
verses.translation: And the dogs shall eat Jezabel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.

verses.geez:
ወወፅአ፡ ኢዩ፡ ኀበ፡ ደቀ፡ እግዚኡ፡ ወይቤልዎ፡ ሰላም፡ ለከ፡ ምንትኑ፡ መጽአ፡ ዝብእሲ፡ ኀቤከ፡ ወይቤሎሙ፡
            ኢታአምርዎኑ፡ ዝብእሲ፡ ከመ፡ በከ፡ ይዛዋዕ።
verses.translation: And Ju went forth to the servants of his lord, and they said to him, Is all well? Why came this mad fellow in to thee? And he said to them, Ye know the man, and his communication.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ፡ ሐሰውከ ፤ ንግረነ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ወይቤሎሙ፡ ኢዩ፡ ለደቁ፡ ከመዝ፡ ወከመዝ፡ ይቤለኒ፡ ወይቤለኒ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡
            እግዚአብሔር፡ ቀባእኩከአ፡ ትንግሥአ፡ ለእስራኤልአ።
verses.translation: And they said, It is wrong: tell us now. And Ju said to them, Thus and thus spoke he to me, saying,—and he said, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee to be king over Israel.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ሰምዑ፡ አስተፋጠኑ፡ ወነጸፉ፡ አልባሲሆሙ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወነጸፉ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኀበ፡ ይነብር፡ ውስተ፡ መዓርግ፡ ወነፍኁ፡ ቀርነ፡ ወይቤሉ፡ ነግሠ፡ ኢዩ።
verses.translation: And when they heard it, they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with the trumpet, and said, Ju is king.

verses.geez: ወጸብአ፡ ኢዩ፡ ወልደ፡ ዮሳፍጥ፡ ወልደ፡ ናሜስ፡ ለኢዮራም፡ ወኢዮራምሰ፡ ሀሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ሬማት፡ ዘገለዓድ፡ የዐቅብዎ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እስራኤል፡ እምነ፡ አዛሔል፡ ንጉሠ፡ ሶርያ።
verses.translation: So Ju the son of Josaphat the son of Namessi conspired against Joram, and Joram was defending Remmoth Galaad, he and all Israel, because of Azael king of Syria.

verses.geez:
ወገብአ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ንጉሥ፡ ኀበ፡ እስራኤል፡ ይትፈወስ፡ እምነ፡ ቍስሉ፡ ዘአቍሰልዎ፡ ሶርያ፡ አመ፡ ተቃተለ፡ ምስለ፡
            አዛሔል፡ ንጉሠ፡ ሶርያ፡ ወይቤሎሙ፡ ኢዩ፡ ለእለ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ትክሉኑ፡ መጥዎ፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ ምስሌየ፡ ዑቁ፡ እንከ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያመስጠክሙ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይወፅእ፡ እምነ፡ ሀገርክሙ፡ ኢይዜንውዎሙ፡ ለእስራኤል።
verses.translation: And king Joram had returned to be healed in Jezrael of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, in his war with Azael king of Syria. And Ju said, If your heart is with me, let there not go forth out of the city one fugitive to go and report to Jezrael.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ፡ ሖረ፡ ኢዩ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ኀበ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወወረደ፡ ወኢዮራምሰ፡ ንጉሠ፡ እስራኤል፡ ሀለወ፡ ውስተ፡ እስራኤል፡
            ይትፌወስ፡ ንድፈቶ፡ ኀበ፡ ነደፍዎ፡ ሶርያ፡ አረማዊያን፡ በሬማት፡ አመ፡ ተቃተለ፡ ምስለ፡ አዛሔል፡ ንጉሠ፡ ሶርያ፡
            እስመ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ብእሲ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወኀያል፡ ውእቱ ፤ ወአካዝያስ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ወረደ፡ ይርአዮ፡ ለኢዮራም።
verses.translation: And Ju rode and advanced, and came down to Jezrael; for Joram king of Israel was getting healed in Jezrael of the arrow-wounds wherewith the Syrians had wounded him in Rammath in the war with Azael king of Syria; for he was strong and a mighty man: and Ochozias king of Juda was come down to see Joram.

verses.geez:
ወዐርገ፡ ሰብአ፡ ዐይን፡ ውስተ፡ ማኅፈድ፡ ይርአዮሙ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ ወርእየ፡ ጸበሎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ኢዩ፡ እንዘ፡ ይመጽኡ፡ ወይቤ፡ ናሁ፡ ጸበለ፡ እሬኢ፡ አንሰ ፤ ወይቤ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ይሖር፡ ፩ያሩጽ፡ ፈረሰ፡ ይትቀበሎሙ፡ ወይበሎሙ፡ ሰላም፡
            ለክሙ።
verses.translation: And there went up a watchman upon the tower of Jezrael, and saw the dust made by Ju as he approached; and he said, I see dust. And Joram said, Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Peace.

verses.geez:
ወሖረ፡ ፩አሮጸ፡ ፈረሰ፡ ወተቀበሎሙ፡ ወይቤሎሙ፡ ሰላም፡ ለክሙ፡ ይቤለክሙ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ኢዩ፡ ምንተ፡ ብከ፡
            ምስለ፡ ሰላም ፤ ግባእ፡ ድኅሬየ ፤ ወነገሮሙ፡ ዝኩ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዐይን፡ ወይቤሎሙ፡ በጽሐ፡ ዘለአክሙ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ ወኢገብአ።
verses.translation: And there went a horseman to meet them, and said, Thus says the king, Peace. And Ju said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn behind me. And the watchman reported, saying, The messenger came up to them, and has not returned.

verses.geez:
ወፈነወ፡ ካዕበ፡ ካልአ፡ ያሩጽ፡ ፈረሰ፡ ወበጽሐ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ ወይቤሎሙ፡ ሰላምአ፡ ለክሙአ፡ ይቤ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወይቤሎ፡
            ኢዩ፡ ምንተ፡ ብከ፡ ምስለ፡ ሰላም ፤ ግባእ፡ ድኅሬየ።
verses.translation: And he sent another horseman, and he came to him, and said, Thus says the king, Peace. And Ju said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn behind me.

verses.geez:
ወነገሮ፡ ዝኩ፡ ሰብአ፡ ዐይን፡ ወይቤሎ፡ በጽሐ፡ ዘለአክሙ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ ወኢተመይጠ ፤ መሪሐ፡ ይመርሖ፡ ለኢዩ፡ ወልደ፡
            ናሜሴ፡ እስመ፡ ካልእት፡ ፍኖቶሙ።
verses.translation: And the watchman reported, saying, He came up to them, and has not returned: and the driver drives Ju the son of Namessi, for it is with furious haste.

verses.geez:
ወይቤ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ንዑ፡ ንሖር፡ ወአሖሩ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ፡ ወወፅአ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ንጉሠ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወአካዝያስ፡ ንጉሠ፡
            ይሁዳ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ በሰረገላቲሆሙ፡ ወሖሩ፡ ወተቀበልዎ፡ ለኢዩ፡ ወረከብዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ናቡቴ፡ እስራኤላዊ።
verses.translation: And Joram said, Make ready. And one made ready the chariot: and Joram the king of Israel went forth, and Ochozias king of Juda, each in his chariot, and they went to meet Ju, and found him in the portion of Nabuthai the Jezraelite.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ሰላም፡ ለኢዩ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ እንከ፡ ኢዩ፡ ምንተ፡ ብከ፡ ምስለ፡ ሰላም፡ አኮኑ፡ ዝሙታ፡ ለእምካ፡ ኢያዛቤል፡ ወሥራያቲሃ፡ በዝኀ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when Joram saw Ju, that he said, Is it peace, Ju? And Ju said, How can it be peace? as yet there are the whoredoms of thy mother Jezabel, and her abundant witchcrafts.

verses.geez: ወተመይጠ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ከመ፡ ይጕየይ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ለአካዝ፡ ተጓሐለወነ፡ አካዝ።
verses.translation: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ochozias, Treachery, Ochozias.

verses.geez:
ወወሰቀ፡ ወመሰከ፡ ቀስቶ፡ በኀይሉ፡ ወነደፎ፡ ለኢዮራም፡ ማእከለ፡ ተኬሳሁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ ሐጹ፡ እንተ፡ ውስተ፡ ልቡ፡
            ወወድቀ፡ በብረኪሁ።
verses.translation: And Ju bent his bow with his full strength, and smote Joram between his arms, and his arrow went out at his heart, and he bowed upon his knees.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ፡ ኢዩ፡ ለበዴቃ፡ ወዓሊሁ፡ ግድፎ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ናቡቴ፡ እስራኤላዊ፡ እስመ፡ አነ፡ እዜከር፡ ወለሊከ፡
            ታአምር፡ አመ፡ ንጼዐን፡ አእዱገ፡ ወንተልዎ፡ ለአካአብ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወአምጽአ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘይቤ ፤
verses.translation: And Ju said to Badecar his chief officer, Cast him into the portion of ground of Nabuthai the Jezraelite, for I and thou remember, riding as we were on chariots after Achaab his father, that the Lord took up this burden against him, saying,

verses.geez: ደሞ፡ ለናቡቴ፡ ወደመ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ትማልም፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወእትበቀሎ፡ በዝ፡ ዐጸድ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወይእዜኒ፡ ንሥኦ፡ ወግድፎ፡ ውስተዝ፡ ዐጸድ፡ በከመ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Surely, I have seen yesterday the blood of Nabuthai, and the blood of his sons, saith the Lord; and I will recompense him in this portion, saith the Lord. Now then, I pray thee, take him up and cast him into the portion, according to the word of the Lord.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ርእየ፡ አካዝያስ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ጐየ፡ እንተ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ቤታን፡ ወተለዎ፡ ኢዩ፡ ወዴገኖ፡ ወይቤ፡ ኢየኀድጎ፡ ኪያሁኒ፡ ወቀተሎ፡ በውስተ፡ ሰረገላቲሁ፡ እንዘ፡ የዐርግ፡ መንገለ፡ ጋይ፡ አንተ፡ ኤብላሔም፡ ወእምህየ፡ ጐየ፡ ውስተ፡ መጌዶን፡ ወበህየ፡ ወፅአት፡ ነፍሱ።
verses.translation: And Ochozias king of Juda saw it, and fled by the way of Bæthgan. And Ju pursued after him, and said, Slay him also. And one smote him in the chariot at the going up of Gai, which is Jeblaam: and he fled to Mageddo, and died there.

verses.geez:
ወጸዐንዎ፡ ደቁ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰረገላቲሁ፡ ወአእተውዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወቀበርዎ፡ ውስተ፡ መቃብሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ሀገረ፡
            ዳዊት።
verses.translation: And his servants put him on a chariot, and brought him to Jerusalem, and they buried him in his sepulchre in the city of David.

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ፲ወ፩ክረምት፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለኢዮራም፡ ንጉሠ፡ እስራኤል፡ ነግሠ፡ አካዝያስ፡ ለይሁዳ።
verses.translation: And in the eleventh year of Joram king of Israel, Ochozias began to reign over Juda.

verses.geez:
ወሖረ፡ ኢዩ፡ ውስተ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወሰምዐት፡ ኢያዛቤል፡ ወተኵሕለት፡ አዕይንቲሃ፡ ወተሠነየት፡ ወተፀፍረት፡ ርእሳ፡
            ወሐወጸት፡ እንተ፡ ውስተ፡ መስኮት።
verses.translation: And Ju came to Jezrael; and Jezabel heard of it, and coloured her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked through the window.

verses.geez: ወቦአ፡ ኢዩ፡ ውስተ፡ ሀገር፡ ወትቤሎ፡ ስላም፡ ለዝንበሪ፡ ለቀታሌ፡ እግዚኡ።
verses.translation: And Ju entered into the city; and she said, Had Zambri, the murderer of his master, peace?

verses.geez: ወአንሥአ፡ ገጾ፡ ወርእያ፡ ውስተ፡ መስኮት፡ ወይቤላ፡ መኑ፡ አንቲ፡ ረዲ፡ ዝየ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ወእምዝ፡ ሐወጹ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ኅጽዋን።
verses.translation: And he lifted up his face toward the window, and saw her, and said, Who art thou? Come down with me. And two eunuchs looked down towards him.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ፡ አጽድፍዋ፡ ወአጽደፍዋ፡ ወተነዝኀ፡ ደማ፡ ኀበ፡ አረፍት፡ ወኀበ፡ አፍራስ፡ ወኬድዋ።
verses.translation: And he said, Throw her down. And they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and they trampled on her.

verses.geez: ወቦአ፡ ኢዩ፡ ወበልዐ፡ ወሰትየ፡ ወእምዝ፡ ይቤ፡ ሖሩ፡ ርእይዋ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ርግምት፡ ወቅብርዋ፡ እስመ፡ ወለተ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ይእቲ።
verses.translation: And Ju went in and ate and drank, and said, Look now, after this cursed woman, and bury her, for she is a king's daughter.

verses.geez: ወሖሩ፡ ይቅብርዋ፡ ወኢረከቡ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ናላሃ፡ ወሰሎና፡ እገሪሃ፡ ወእራኃተ፡ እደዊሃ።
verses.translation: And they went to bury her; but they found nothing of her but the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.

verses.geez:
ወገብኡ፡ ወነገርዎ፡ ወይቤ፡ ዝክቱ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘነበለ፡ በእደ፡ ኤልያስ፡ ትስብያዊ፡ ወይቤ፡ በውስተ፡
            ዐጸደ፡ እስራኤል፡ ይበልዕዋ፡ ከለባት፡ ለኤልዛቤል ፤
verses.translation: And they returned and told him. And he said, It is the word of the Lord, which he spoke by the hand of Eliu the Thesbite, saying, In the portion of Jezrael shall the dogs eat the flesh of Jezabel.

verses.geez: [ወይከውን፡ በድና፡ ለኤልዛቤል፡] ከመ፡ መሬት፡ ውስተ፡ ገጸ፡ ገዳም፡ በደወለ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ኢይበልዋ፡ እንከ፡ ኢያዜቤል።
verses.translation: And the carcase of Jezabel shall be as dung on the face of the field in the portion of Jezrael, so that they shall not say, This is Jezabel.
